title: Ziyarat of Imam Husayn on Qadr & Eid
urduTitle: زیارت امام حسین شب قدر و عید
intro: One shared form of ziyarat associated with Laylat al-Qadr and Eid, kept on a single canonical page.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Husayn on Qadr & Eid with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: Ziyarat of Imam Husain(as) on Laylat ul Qadr and Eid

This Ziarat of Imam Hussain (as) is specific for the Laylatul Qadr and the "Day" of Eid
According to Hadith, during Lailat-e-Qadr an angel proclaims from the Arsh (throne) on the Seventh sky that Allah has forgiven who have visited the grave of Imam Hussain (as).
It is also recited on 1st 15th and End of the Month of Ramadhan.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ ٱلصِّدِّيقَةِ ٱلطَّاهِرَةِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the veracious, immaculate lady
Fatimah the Doyenne of the women of the world.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ يَا ابَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O my master Abu-`Abdullah.
So be upon you Allah’s mercy and blessings.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
recited the Book (i.e. the Holy Qur'an) as exactly as it should be recited,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: strove for the sake of Allah as exactly as striving must be,

blocks.arabic: وَصَبَرْتَ عَلَىٰ ٱلاذَىٰ فِي جَنْبِهِ مُحْتَسِباً حَتَّىٰ اتَاكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
blocks.transliteration: wa sabarta `ala al-adha fi janbihi muhtasiban hatta ataka alyaqinu
blocks.english: and faced all troubles steadfastly for His sake, seeking his reward, until death came upon you.

blocks.transliteration: wa ashhadu anna alladhina khalafuka wa harabuka
blocks.english: I also bear witness that those who dissented you, those who fought against you,

blocks.transliteration: wa anna alladhina khadhaluka walladhina qataluka
blocks.english: those who let you down, and those who slew you
(all those) were accursed directly by the Meccan Prophet.
And he who forges lies indeed fails to attain his desire.

blocks.arabic: لَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ لَكُمْ مِنَ ٱلاوَّلِينَ وَٱلآخِرِينَ
blocks.transliteration: la`ana allahu alzzalimina lakum min al-awwalina wal-akhirina
blocks.english: May Allah curse those who wronged you from amongst the past and the present generations.
May Allah also double for them the painful torment.

blocks.arabic: اتَيْتُكَ يَا مَوْلايَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: ataytuka ya mawlaya yabna rasuli allahi
blocks.english: O my master and son of Allah’s Messenger, I have come to you
visiting you, acknowledging the standing that you enjoy,
declaring my loyalty to those who are loyal to you,
renouncing your enemies,
seeking to follow the true guidance that you are following,
and recognizing the deviation of those who oppose you;
so, (please) intercede for me before your Lord.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجّةَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ارْضِهِ وَسَمَائِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi fi ardihi wa sama'ihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Argument of Allah in His lands and heavens.

blocks.arabic: صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ رُوحِكَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ وَجَسَدِكَ ٱلطَّاهِرِ
blocks.transliteration: salla allahu `ala ruhika alttayyibi wa jasadika alttahiri
blocks.english: May Allah bless your immaculate spirit and your pure body.

blocks.arabic: وَعَلَيْكَ ٱلسَّلاَمُ يَا مَوْلاَيَ وَرَحْمَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَاتُهُ
blocks.transliteration: wa `alayka alssalamu ya mawlaya wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace and Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you, O my master.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ وَٱبْنَ مَوْلاَيَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O my master and son of my master.
So be upon you Allah’s mercy and blessings.
May Allah curse those who wronged you.
May Allah curse those who slew you.
May Allah double the painful chastisement for them.

blocks.text:
You may then pray Almighty Allah for your personal needs.
Ziyarat of All Martyrs (Shohada e Karbala)

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O veracious ones.
Peace be upon you, O steadfast martyrs.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكُمْ جَاهَدْتُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annakum jahadtum fi sabili allahi
blocks.english: I bear witness that you strove in the way of Allah,

blocks.arabic: وَصَبَرْتُمْ عَلَىٰ ٱلاذَىٰ فِي جَنْبِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa sabartum `ala al-adha fi janbi allahi
blocks.english: acted patiently against harm for the sake of Allah,

blocks.arabic: وَنَصَحْتُمْ لِلَّهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ حَتَّىٰ اتَاكُمُ ٱلْيَقِينُ
blocks.transliteration: wa nasahtum lillahi wa lirasulihi hatta atakum alyaqinu
blocks.english: and did sincerely for the sake of Allah and His Messenger until death came upon you.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ انّكُمْ احْيَاءٌ عِنْدَ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْزَقُونَ
blocks.english: I bear witness that you are alive and are being provided sustenance from your Lord.

blocks.arabic: فَجَزَاكُمُ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلإِسْلاَمِ وَاهْلِهِ افْضَلَ جَزَاءِ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
blocks.transliteration: fajazakum allahu `an al-islami wa ahlihi afdala jaza'i almuhsinina
blocks.english: May Allah reward you with the best reward of the good-doers on behalf of Islam and its people

blocks.arabic: وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ فِي مَحَلِّ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
blocks.transliteration: wa jama`a baynana wa baynakum fi mahalli alnna`imi
blocks.english: and may He join us to you in the abode of bliss.

blocks.text: Ziyarat of H. Abbas ibn Ameerul Momineen (as)

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ امِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.
Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)
and obedient to Allah and to His Messenger.

blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad jahadta wa nasahta
blocks.english: I bear witness that you strove (in the way of Allah), acted sincerely,
and tolerated (harm) until death came upon you.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام حسین شب قدر و عید کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
